# How the unchanged playbook opens on Nightmare 20

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Status | done |
| Area | meta |
| Result | confirmed |
| Created | L1.I6 |
| Updated | L1.I10 |

## Hypothesis

The unchanged playbook with spud-cannon survives only a short while on Nightmare 20, and the damage sources and early chest timing show what to fix first for the campaign goal.

## Method

Play the opening-nm20 gym for 150 s with the playbook as it is. Read health by minute, chests opened, damage by weapon and the killer.

## Findings

The unchanged playbook survives only a short while on Nightmare 20. Spud-cannon lasted 150 s at 20/120 health. Starch-chain 8 + hot-sauce died at 1:35, hash-hawk 8 + bacon-bits at 1:13, fry-sentry 8 + slow-cooker at 0:36, all with no chest. Three elites of about 4000 hp arrive at 0:34-1:00, before any chest is listed. Nightmare 20 stays a later target.
